# anthropic_compliance_roles (Data Source)

Lists the custom RBAC roles defined on one linked organization. Requires `compliance_api_key` (a Compliance Access Key) or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying the `read:compliance_org_data` scope; Admin API keys are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_compliance_roles" "example" {
  organization_uuid = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_uuid` (String) Organization UUID.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) Roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Role description; may be null.
- `id` (String) Role id (`rbac_role_...`).
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
